Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1161
Claimant:
Kenneth Brown
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
August 20, 2023
Claim opened for a side impact at an intersection involving the insured vehicle and a third-party vehicle. The claimant
reports a wrist fratcure from the impact and is not represented by an attorney.
September 15, 2023
Confirmed the driver is listed as a named driver on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss.
Requested the police report and statements from the scene.
September 26, 2023
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of the
collision. The other driver's account matches the claimant's description of how the crash happened.
November 6, 2023
Reviewed scene photographs and the vehicle damage estimate. The damage is mostly consistent with the described
side impact, though a few old scratches on the lower panel may predate this crash and are being noted separately.
November 16, 2023
Spoke with a neighbor who believes the car had body damage several weeks before the stated loss date. The
statement is unverified and will be checked against repair records and prior photos.
February 29, 2024
Claimant has given the same account of the collision in each conversation, including sequence of vehicles, signal
status and point of impact. No inconsistencies noted to date.
March 2, 2024
Medical records show the wrist fracture is a plausible injury for a crash of this type. Claimant reports no prior injury to
the same wrist or arm, and none appears in the records requested so far.
March 25, 2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with follow-up visits tapering as the claimant's range of motion and pain
improved. Provider notes desrcibe steady recovery.
April 13, 2024
File reviewed with the neighbor's statement and the older scratches still open for follow-up. Remaining items are
repair records and the prior photo request before a coverage and valuation decision is made.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
